title: Connected Textures By Blond
body:
![The cover image for the resource pack, featuring a bunch of connected textures.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6abda2fd74d34a00c760dc8c15ead67637bd1d5f.png)

This is a resource pack that takes a bunch of Minecraft's textures and connects them together!

"Aren't there already tons of these kinds of resource packs?", I hear you ask, and the answer to that question is... kinda not really? Sure, there are plenty connected texture packs out there, but most of them are either incomplete, not up to date, or have rather *interesting* design choices.

The goal of *this* connected texture pack is to provide a definitive CTM experience. This shouldn't be *a* CTM pack, it should be ***the*** CTM pack!

### Disclaimer
This definitive CTM experience doesn't support connected glass right now. I'll get it done soon!  Before 26.3!! I promise!!! [' > ,]

Speaking of missing support, this definitive CTM experience is also not complete and is still in development. Pretty much everything important is done (except glass [*' > ,*]), but there are still plenty of blocks I want to add CTM support to including but not limited to workstations and chiseled blocks!

### Compatibility
This resource pack requires a mod that uses either uses the **McPatcher CTM** format or the **Fusion CTM** format. (Yea it works with both lol d[^ ^ ]z)
- [Continuity](https://modrinth.com/mod/continuity) and [OptiFine](https://optifine.net/home) support the **McPatcher CTM** format.
- [Fusion](https://modrinth.com/mod/fusion-connected-textures) supports the **Fusion CTM** format.
- I didn't know ConnectedTexturesMod, ya know, the mod called "CTM", doesn't use the classic McPatcher CTM format. I'll look into adding support for it at some point in the future.

This pack also has a sister pack called [Connected Double Slabs By Blond](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/connected-double-slabs-by-blond) which gives double slab blocks their own textures for building and distinguishability!

### Special Thanks
**MASSIVE** shoutout to my best friend for making a program to help create the texture files needed for all of this to work. This whole thing *would* have been possible without Jake's help, but *man* it would've been slow and painful.

The tool is [here](https://github.com/JakeThe28th/ctm_tool) if you want to check it out and use it yourself!

<summary>Terms of Use</summary>
  
For the sake of transparency, while this is under All Rights Reserved, there are plenty of things you are allowed to do with this resource pack. *Note that this list is subject to change in the future. Likely if I find a license that actually has all this stuff included.*
  
### You are allowed to:
- Include this resource pack in any modpacks, videos, and/or showcases. While not required, linking back to this project would be *highly* appreciated!
- Make and upload your own resource packs using this style to add support for more mods provided you try not to include files from this project and clarify that it was made by someone else. "Unofficial", if you will.
- Steal and modify non-unique assets from this project to help make your own resource packs (like the pack.mcmeta file). Ye.

### You are ***NOT*** allowed to:
- Reupload this pack to other resource pack hosting sites, *especially* not scammy ones.
- Port this resource pack to Minecraft: Bedrock Edition, or any other Minecrafts, Bedrocks, or Editions.
- Redistribute a modified version of this resource pack.
- Attempt to sell this thing. Come on now.
- Steal unique assets. Generic stuff like core shaders and "items" .json files are perfectly fine to take and reference, but don't grab a texture from this and put it into your own pack please.
- To reiterate, my resource packs are only available on Modrinth and CurseForge (and sometimes GitHub). **If you are reading this, are not on one of those two platforms and the thief was stupid enough to leave this message in, you should probably leave, purge everything to do with the site you were just on, and run an antivirus scan.**
</details>
